ruling: Permissible during travel of approximately 82km or more. Can combine Zuhr+Asr or Maghrib+Isha (jam' taqdim or ta'khir).
Only permitted at Arafah (Zuhr+Asr) and Muzdalifah (Maghrib+Isha) during Hajj.
Permissible during travel. Also permitted for rain, mud, illness, and fear.
Permissible during travel, illness, rain, extreme cold, and genuine hardship.
If one eats or drinks forgetfully, the fast is valid and should be completed. No makeup required.
Eating or drinking forgetfully does not break the fast. Continue fasting.

Zakat is obligatory when wealth reaches the nisab: 85 grams of gold or 595 grams of silver (or equivalent currency), held for one lunar year.
source: Agreed upon by all four schools

ruling: Zakat on income is calculated at 2.5% of net savings that exceed nisab at the end of the haul (lunar year).
Zakat is due on savings exceeding nisab at year-end. Income spent before year-end is not zakatable.
Modern scholars in Malaysia (JAKIM) recommend 2.5% of gross annual income minus essential expenses, payable monthly or annually.
